additional_info.subject: ID0430288-DC/Si-D/FR-[Multiple] Lost Backend Connection CRM:02889000093
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
I checked the chargers and they are online again. I found that the charger 7atf9c has a problem with the SIM card:
As you can see, the Sim is not recognized. I already tried a reboot and didn't work.
Please check on-site if the SIM is properly inserted, if it is, then please check if putting a piece of paper between the SIM and the Tray works, to close the gap between the reader.
Otherwise, please replace the router.
I will send this to your queue.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
